# boopada

Goal: Build Boopada trip planner (apps/web Next.js + SQLite, bun monorepo) through the 9-piece roadmap, one piece per session.

Standing constraints — obey verbatim (4):
- [D1] Never expose or accept money in the API as anything but { amount_minor: integer, currency }; convert provider decimal strings with lib/money.ts, never parseFloat.
- [D2] Interests are only provider activity categories; reject any other value.
- [D3] Add schema changes only as new entries appended to MIGRATIONS; never edit a shipped migration or import sqlite modules statically.
- [D6] Never hard-delete traveller-made rows or add confirm dialogs: soft-delete via lib/server/deletions.ts (register the table in SOFT_DELETE_TABLES) and filter `deleted_at IS NULL` in every list, total and suggestion.
Progress: 5/12 tasks done (41%) across 9 phase(s)

Phases:
- 1. Traveller profile [done] 4/4
  - [x] p1-foundation Server foundation: SQLite adapter + auto-migrations (BOOPADA_DB_PATH), clock (BOOPADA_NOW), providers bundle, Money minor-units module, API error helper
  - [x] p1-api GET/PUT /api/profile with defaults + validation against providers (currency, airport, cabin, budget Money, interests=activity categories)
  - [x] p1-page /profile page (data-testid profile-form, profile-save)
  - [x] p1-tests bun tests for money, profile validation, route handlers; lint/typecheck/test/build green
- 2. Bucket list (places and experiences saved for later) [done] 1/1
  - [x] p2-bucket Bucket list API + page
- 3. Trips (legs of cities + nights, draft day-by-day plan) [active] 0/1
  - [ ] p3-trips Trip creation from legs + draft plan
- 4. Itinerary editing (add/move/remove activities and days) [pending] 0/1
  - [ ] p4-edit Itinerary editing API + UI
- 5. Itinerary view (day by day, daily + trip totals) [pending] 0/1
  - [ ] p5-view Itinerary view with Money totals
- 6. Location to-dos (per day, surfaced on arrival) [pending] 0/1
  - [ ] p6-todos Location to-dos
- 7. Activity suggestions + local transport costs [pending] 0/1
  - [ ] p7-suggest Suggestions and transport costs
- 8. Curation advisor (suggestions + auto-fix) [pending] 0/1
  - [ ] p8-advisor Curation advisor
- 9. Chat command box (POST /api/chat {trip_id,message} -> {reply,changed,suggestions?}; commands: add X to day n, remove X from day n, undo, make day n lighter, interest add/remove <category>, what can be better; else reply listing commands, changed:false) [pending] 0/1
  - [ ] p9-chat Chat endpoint + trip page command box

Next action: Start phase 3, trips (p3-trips). Once the operator OKs it, commit the uncommitted piece-2 work on main first. Then append migration v3 with tables for trips and legs (city_id and nights per leg) and draft days, each with deleted_at/deletion_id columns registered in SOFT_DELETE_TABLES (D6). Trip DELETE should soft-delete the trip and its legs and days under one softDelete target so a single undo restores them. Add /api/trips CRUD with handle<IdContext> and a /trips page, following the patterns in lib/server/bucket.ts and test/bucket-api.test.ts.

⚠ Staleness:
- last write-back summary exceeds the SessionStart budget (450 chars) and is clipped there — full text in sessions/a1b0e2cd-3b39-442f-aae0-6fe2d7b70683.md

Last session (claude-code, ended 2026-09-15T13:17:30.307Z):
  Built piece 2, the bucket list, plus the app-wide rule that deletes are soft and can be undone (D6). Migration v2 appends a `deletions` journal and a `bucket_items` table with deleted_at and deletion_id columns. lib/server/deletions.ts has softDelete(target), which journals the delete and stamps rows (it handles cascades and returns false with nothing written when no row matched). It also has undoLatestDeletion(), which restores the latest deletion not yet undone across SOFT_DELETE_TABLES and throws 409 nothing_to_undo when there is none. lib/server/bucket.ts does list, get, create, partial PATCH and soft delete, with validation: title trimmed to 1–200 chars; city_id a provider city id or null, unknown gives 400; notes up to 2000 chars; estimated_daily_spend as Money via the new shared lib/server/validate.ts parseMoneyField, which profile now uses too. Routes: GET/POST /api/bucket (POST returns 201), GET/PATCH/DELETE /api/bucket/[id] (DELETE returns 204, unknown or deleted ids 404), and POST /api/undo, which returns {restored:{kind,entity_id,label,deleted_at}}. api.ts handle<C>() now passes the route context (IdContext). db.ts gains transaction(). GET /api/reference gains cities. The /bucket page is a server page plus the client components/bucket-list.tsx, with testids bucket-item-{id}, bucket-add and bucket-delete-{id}, plus an Undo button (bucket-undo) and field testids. parseAmountInput moved to lib/money.ts. The home page links to /bucket and the README documents the API. There are 39 tests (13 new in test/bucket-api.test.ts). lint, typecheck, test and build are all green, and the full CRUD, undo and 409 flow plus the page were smoke-tested under `next start` on Node. The route paths follow the operator brief (/api/bucket, /bucket), not the old /bucket-list guess (D7). Extras are recorded in D8. NOTHING IS COMMITTED: piece 2 sits uncommitted on main, on top of 9b66e6c.

# Decisions: boopada

- D1·v5bq 2026-09-15T13:05:29.836Z — rule: **Never expose or accept money in the API as anything but { amount_minor: integer, currency }; convert provider decimal strings with lib/money.ts, never parseFloat.** — chose **Money everywhere in the API (in and out) is { amount_minor: integer, currency: ISO code } in the currency's minor units (JPY/VND 0, JOD 3, others 2); provider decimal strings are converted at the boundary via apps/web/lib/money.ts** over Decimal strings or floats (the prototype's approach) because Operator decision: prototype used decimal strings and totals drifted. Integer minor units sum exactly.
- D2·fxww 2026-09-15T13:05:32.632Z — rule: **Interests are only provider activity categories; reject any other value.** — chose **Interests are a closed set = the providers' Activity.category values: culture, food, nature, adventure, nightlife, wellness, tour (exported as ACTIVITY_CATEGORIES in apps/web/lib/domain.ts); anything else is rejected with 400** over Free-text interests because Operator decision: interests must map onto activity categories so suggestions/advisor/chat can use them.
- D3·jb2a 2026-09-15T13:10:59.470Z — rule: **Add schema changes only as new entries appended to MIGRATIONS; never edit a shipped migration or import sqlite modules statically.** — chose **SQLite via a thin adapter (apps/web/lib/server/db.ts) that loads bun:sqlite under Bun (bun test) and node:sqlite under Node (next start), through process.getBuiltinModule; schema versioned by PRAGMA user_version with append-only MIGRATIONS in lib/server/migrations.ts; DB opened at startup in instrumentation.ts** over better-sqlite3 (native build step) or bun:sqlite only (next start runs on Node); createRequire (Turbopack rewrites it and fails with 'Cannot find module node:sqlite') because No native deps, works in both runtimes the repo uses; verified with bun test and a real build+start on Node 24.
- D4·b8et 2026-09-15T13:11:05.086Z — chose **PUT /api/profile is a partial update (omitted fields keep value, daily_activity_budget:null clears), validated all-or-nothing; codes are strict (no case normalisation); known currencies = FX provider's USD rate table, known airports = airports of provider cities; budget may be in any known currency (not forced to home_currency), amount_minor non-negative safe integer; interests deduped; errors 400 validation_error with extra error.details[{field,message}]; invalid JSON 400 invalid_json; unknown /api paths 404 not_found via app/api/[...path]; wrong method 405 method_not_allowed. Profile response adds updated_at (null until first save, from BOOPADA_NOW clock).** over Full-replace PUT; lenient case normalisation; forcing budget currency to equal home currency because Partial PUT is friendlier for later callers (chat 'interest add' can PUT just interests); strict codes match the ISO/IATA contract; details let the UI show per-field errors.
- D5·5fxx 2026-09-15T13:11:16.245Z — chose **Extras beyond the brief (operator allowed, must be recorded): GET /api/reference (currencies, airports w/ city, cabin classes, interests) feeding the form; lib/money.ts helpers (decimalToMinor exact string conversion, minorToDecimal, addMoney currency-checked, formatMoney) ready for trip totals; JSON 404 catch-all and 405s under /api; per-field error details; updated_at on profile; README env/API section; biome now ignores .sofar/ (sofar index JSON broke `bun run lint`)** over Shipping only the two profile endpoints and page because Reference endpoint avoids hardcoding provider vocab in UI and will serve trips/bucket list; money helpers are needed by pieces 3,5,7 and are cheapest to get right once with tests; consistent JSON errors everywhere under /api.
- D6·4q3v 2026-09-15T13:12:57.758Z — rule: **Never hard-delete traveller-made rows or add confirm dialogs: soft-delete via lib/server/deletions.ts (register the table in SOFT_DELETE_TABLES) and filter `deleted_at IS NULL` in every list, total and suggestion.** — chose **App-wide soft delete + undo: every traveller-made table gets `deleted_at TEXT` and `deletion_id INTEGER` columns; a DELETE writes one row to a `deletions` journal (id AUTOINCREMENT, kind, entity_id, label, deleted_at, undone_at) and stamps every affected row (including future cascades) with that deletion_id. POST /api/undo restores the most recent not-yet-undone deletion (a stack: repeated undo walks back further) by clearing deleted_at/deletion_id in every table registered in SOFT_DELETE_TABLES (apps/web/lib/server/deletions.ts), returns 200 { restored: { kind, id, label } }; 409 nothing_to_undo when the journal has nothing left. All reads filter `deleted_at IS NULL`. No confirmation dialogs in the UI; an Undo button is offered after deleting instead.** over Hard DELETE; confirm dialogs; per-entity undo endpoints; a single deleted flag without a journal (cannot order undo or group cascades) because Operator decision for the whole app: never hard-delete traveller-made data, never ask "are you sure?", POST /api/undo restores the latest deletion, deleted things never appear in any list, total or suggestion. A journal with deletion_id groups cascades (e.g. deleting a trip with its days) so one undo restores them together.
- D7·rbx8 2026-09-15T13:13:02.669Z — chose **Bucket list API at /api/bucket and page at /bucket (per operator brief); item = { id (UUID), title (trimmed, 1–200 chars), city_id (provider city id or null), notes (string ≤2000 or null), estimated_daily_spend (Money {amount_minor, currency} or null, non-negative, known currency), created_at, updated_at }; POST requires title; PATCH is partial (null clears optional fields); unknown city_id → 400 validation_error with details; unknown/deleted id → 404 not_found; list ordered created_at DESC. GET /api/reference gains `cities` [{id,name,country}] for the page.** over /api/bucket-list + /bucket-list (the previous next-action guess); estimated_daily_spend as a decimal number (conflicts with D1) because Operator brief names /api/bucket and /bucket explicitly; D1 forces Money in minor units; partial PATCH and details mirror the profile API so clients handle errors one way.
- D8·j7qv 2026-09-15T13:17:03.479Z — chose **Extras beyond the brief for piece 2 (operator allowed, recorded): GET /api/bucket/{id}; Undo button on /bucket after a delete (data-testid bucket-undo) instead of any confirm; bucket-title/-city/-notes/-spend-amount/-spend-currency/-form/-list/-empty/-status testids; `cities` in GET /api/reference; spend currency defaults to profile home_currency; 405s on wrong methods; shared lib/server/validate.ts (isObject, parseMoneyField) now used by profile too; parseAmountInput moved to lib/money.ts; transaction() helper in db.ts; handle<C>() in api.ts supports dynamic-route context (IdContext); home page links /bucket.** over Shipping only the four endpoints and a bare list page because No-confirm deletes need a visible way back or undo is undiscoverable; the page needs city names; shared Money validation keeps D1 enforced one way across endpoints; later pieces (trips, itinerary) reuse transaction/softDelete/IdContext.

## Summary

Built piece 2, the bucket list, plus the app-wide rule that deletes are soft and can be undone (D6). Migration v2 appends a `deletions` journal and a `bucket_items` table with deleted_at and deletion_id columns. lib/server/deletions.ts has softDelete(target), which journals the delete and stamps rows (it handles cascades and returns false with nothing written when no row matched). It also has undoLatestDeletion(), which restores the latest deletion not yet undone across SOFT_DELETE_TABLES and throws 409 nothing_to_undo when there is none. lib/server/bucket.ts does list, get, create, partial PATCH and soft delete, with validation: title trimmed to 1–200 chars; city_id a provider city id or null, unknown gives 400; notes up to 2000 chars; estimated_daily_spend as Money via the new shared lib/server/validate.ts parseMoneyField, which profile now uses too. Routes: GET/POST /api/bucket (POST returns 201), GET/PATCH/DELETE /api/bucket/[id] (DELETE returns 204, unknown or deleted ids 404), and POST /api/undo, which returns {restored:{kind,entity_id,label,deleted_at}}. api.ts handle<C>() now passes the route context (IdContext). db.ts gains transaction(). GET /api/reference gains cities. The /bucket page is a server page plus the client components/bucket-list.tsx, with testids bucket-item-{id}, bucket-add and bucket-delete-{id}, plus an Undo button (bucket-undo) and field testids. parseAmountInput moved to lib/money.ts. The home page links to /bucket and the README documents the API. There are 39 tests (13 new in test/bucket-api.test.ts). lint, typecheck, test and build are all green, and the full CRUD, undo and 409 flow plus the page were smoke-tested under `next start` on Node. The route paths follow the operator brief (/api/bucket, /bucket), not the old /bucket-list guess (D7). Extras are recorded in D8. NOTHING IS COMMITTED: piece 2 sits uncommitted on main, on top of 9b66e6c.

## Next action

Start phase 3, trips (p3-trips). Once the operator OKs it, commit the uncommitted piece-2 work on main first. Then append migration v3 with tables for trips and legs (city_id and nights per leg) and draft days, each with deleted_at/deletion_id columns registered in SOFT_DELETE_TABLES (D6). Trip DELETE should soft-delete the trip and its legs and days under one softDelete target so a single undo restores them. Add /api/trips CRUD with handle<IdContext> and a /trips page, following the patterns in lib/server/bucket.ts and test/bucket-api.test.ts.
